programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: Praxx Fim De Semana
programme.desc: Inverno, sexta-feira. Um grupo de jovens universitários parte para um fim de semana em São João da Cruz, para celebrar a sua ascensão na prestigiada Associação da Vida Académica. A diversão dos jovens acaba por dar lugar ao terror quando à noite, na Praia da Cruz, um ritual de praxe é levado ao limite.

programme.title: Os Medos De Rain
programme.desc: Uma rapariga que vive com esquizofrenia luta com alucinações terríveis quando começa a suspeitar que o seu vizinho sequestrou uma criança. A única pessoa que acredita nela é Caleb, um miúdo que ela nem tem a certeza de que existe.

programme.title: True Justice A Vingança É Minha
programme.desc: Depois da sua antiga equipa ter sido assassinada, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane recruta novos membros para formar um esquadrão implacável de combate ao crime, prometendo vingar a morte dos antigos companheiros.

programme.title: True Justice Via De Sangue
programme.desc: Elijah Kane envolve-se numa nova missão governamental para tentar apanhar um mafioso envolvido em tráfico de pessoas e descobre uma conspiração mais alargada de venda de órgãos humanos.

programme.title: True Justice Ações Violentas
programme.desc: Enquanto investiga o desaparecimento de uma carrinha de segurança que transportava 20 milhões de dólares, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane vai enfrentar um perigoso mafioso, uma organização misteriosa chamada Quicksilver e uma figura do passado que ele e a CIA julgavam morta.

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa, uma rapariga bem-comportada de dezoito anos, conhece na faculdade Hardin, um rapaz rude e rico com um passado sombrio, por quem se apaixona e com o qual perde a virgindade. Os dois embarcam numa relação turbulenta e intensa, que os mudará para sempre.

programme.title: Está Tudo Louco
programme.desc: Um magnata jogador decide criar um novo veículo para apostas a dinheiro uma corrida de mais de 900 quilómetros, de um casino de Las Vegas até uma estação de comboio no Novo México, onde se encontra um saco com dois milhões de dólares, que ficará para quem lá chegar primeiro.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Pelé O Nascimento De Uma Lenda
programme.desc: Esta é a extraordinária história do lendário jogador de futebol Pelé, desde a sua infância até se tornar no jovem que, aos 17 anos de idade, marcou o golo decisivo na primeira vitória de sempre do Brasil num Campeonato do Mundo, em 1958.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos

programme.title: Dog A Aventura De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Briggs, um ex-ranger do exército, é encarregue de conduzir Lulu, um pastor belga militar de comportamento agressivo, pela costa do Pacífico até ao funeral do seu dono, numa jornada em que ambos terão de lidar com os traumas do seu passado e encontrar um ponto de equilíbrio.

programme.title: Estado De Guerra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra do Iraque, um novo sargento assume o comando de uma equipa altamente treinada em desmantelamento de bombas. No meio de conflitos violentos, com a cidade a explodir num absoluto caos, ele vai revelar a sua verdadeira personalidade e mudará para sempre aqueles homens.

programme.title: Pandemónio
programme.desc: Quando um vírus letal, capaz de tornar as pessoas extremamente violentas e selvagens, se alastra num edifício de escritórios, o advogado Derek Cho e uma cliente insatisfeita terão de unir esforços para lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Henrique V
programme.desc: No decorrer da Guerra dos Cem Anos, o jovem rei Henrique V de Inglaterra lidera o seu exército na luta contra França em 1415.

programme.title: True Justice Anjo Da Morte
programme.desc: O antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane enfrenta terroristas que tentam traficar bombas nucleares em malas de viagem, desconfiando que é o seu maior inimigo quem está a tentar apanhá-las.

programme.title: True Justice A Hora De Morrer
programme.desc: A busca pelas malas de viagem com bombas nucleares continua mas agora o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane suspeita que o seu contacto na CIA esteja a trabalhar contra ele.

programme.title: True Justice O Fantasma
programme.desc: O antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane está cada vez mais perto do inimigo que todos procuram, o Fantasma, mas quando tudo se parece encaminhar para o fim, o FBI começa a investigar o próprio Kane e os seus métodos de investigação menos convencionais e tudo se complica ainda mais.

programme.title: Um Dia De Chuva Em Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Gatsby e Ashleigh são um casal de estudantes de faculdade que passam um fim-de-semana a visitar Nova Iorque, onde ela tem a tarefa de entrevistar um realizador de cinema para o jornal da universidade e onde ambos vão viver várias aventuras que vão provocar um sério abalo na sua relação.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoé
programme.desc: Numa pequena ilha paradisíaca, o papagaio Terça-feira e o seu grupo de animais amigos encontram o náufrago Robinson Crusoé. No início, o convívio não é fácil mas lentamente, todos começam a viver juntos em harmonia, pelo menos até dois gatos virem colocar tudo em risco.

programme.title: Torque - A Lei Do Mais Rápido
programme.desc: Um motoqueiro regressa da Tailândia para resolver a relação com a namorada, só que o líder de um gangue quer apanhá-lo para o forçar a devolver duas motos cheias de droga e outro quer matá-lo por lhe ter assassinado o irmão.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: A Máscara
programme.desc: O tímido bancário Stanley Ipkiss encontra uma mascara misteriosa. Quando a coloca, transforma-se num ser enérgico e ultra-acelerado, de rosto verde e poderes muito especiais.

programme.title: Conspiração Terrorista
programme.desc: Alice Racine é uma agente da CIA não conseguiu evitar um ataque terrorista que dizimou dezenas de vítimas e que é forçada a voltar à ação para tentar neutralizar um brutal ataque ao território britânico com uma arma biológica.

programme.title: Um Ranger Especial
programme.desc: Alex Tyree é um Texas Ranger que persegue o assaltante de bancos Declan McBride através do deserto, quando descobre que ele é um terrorista internacional que tenciona detonar uma bomba no coração de Londres.

programme.title: Magia E Sedução
programme.desc: Sally e Gillian Owens são duas irmãs descendentes de uma família de bruxas que carrega uma maldição centenária. Agora elas terão de enfrentar vários feitiços inesperados e ultrapassar todos os obstáculos para encontrar o verdadeiro amor.

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: Bullitt
programme.desc: O tenente Frank Bullitt é um polícia de San Francisco com pouca paciência para as regras, que fará tudo para apanhar o barão do crime que mandou matar a testemunha que estava sob sua proteção.

programme.title: Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
programme.desc: Italian conductor Speranza Scappucci leads the Philharmonia Zürich and the Chorus of the Opernhaus Zürich in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s tragic opera ‘Lucia di Lammermoor’ (1835). Salvatore Cammarano based his libretto on Sir Walter Scott’s novel ‘The Bride of Lammermoor’ (1819). Set in 17th century Scotland, the opera tells the story of Lucia, who falls in love with Edgardo, her family’s arch enemy.

programme.title: Handel at Chambord Castle
programme.desc: This 2016 concert at Chambord Castle in France under the direction of Hervé Niquet features 70 musicians that gave a spectacular performance of Handel‘s Water Music and Music for the Royal Fireworks. In between Le Concert Spirituel also plays Concerto Grosso’s No. 4 and No. 5 also by Georg Friedrich Handel.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 99
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Trio élégiaque No. 1
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 3, 8 And 11
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Piano works by Bruckner
programme.desc: Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) has won several prizes at international piano competitions, such as the Schubert Competition in Dortmund, the William Kapell International Piano Competition in Maryland, and the 29th Masterplayers International Music Competition in Lugano. Moreover, the pianist has performed in several European countries, Japan, and the USA , and has played at many international music festivals.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K.

programme.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn And Gershwin for 2 Pianos
programme.desc: Italian pianists Roberto Prosseda and Alessandra Ammara perform W. A. Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 488, Felix Mendelssohn's Sonata for two pianos in D major, MWV S 1, and George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, during an off-season concert recorded at Fazioli Concert Hall in Sacile, Italy in June 26, 2020.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony - Legends And Quests
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris. The program continues with Shostakovich's Symphony No.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Mozart - Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622
programme.desc: Conductor Marien van Staalen leads Amadeus Ensemble Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622. Henk de Graaf is the featured soloist. This performance was recorded at St. Nicholas Church in Vollenhove, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Initially, the superstitious composer, believing in the so-called ‘curse of the ninth,’ did not want to write a Symphony No. 9.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Mozart - Così fan tutte
programme.desc: Maestro Zubin Mehta leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s comic opera Così fan tutte (1790). Following the successful operas Le nozze di Figaro (1786) and Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte was the third and last collaboration between Mozart and the Venetian librettist and poet Lorenzo Da Ponte.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo And Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’ (1835-1921) Symphony No. 3, Op. 78. Geert Bierling stars as soloist on the organ of De Doelen. It was recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Saint-Saëns Symphony No. 3 was completed in 1886. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Entre Pernas
programme.desc: Os dois encontram-se pela primeira vez numa reunião de grupo para viciados em sexo. Ela é Miranda, redatora de um programa de rádio noturno e que se aproveita, nos seus passeios matinais como o cão para ter encontros sexuais com todo o tipo de homens. Ele é Javier, talentoso roteirista e produtor de cinema, que está preso a uma relação doentia, por telefone, com uma mulher misteriosa que lhe conta as suas aventuras sexuais.Os dois...

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 51
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: November Music 2017: Daniel Herskedal
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands. Norwegian tuba player and composer Daniel Herskedal trained at the Trondheim and Copenhagen Music Conservatories.

programme.title: Trio Corrente - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Nica's Dream
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kurt Elling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Ochun Chucho
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Joel Hierrezuelo - Asi de Simple
programme.desc: Cuban singer, guitarist and percussionist Joel Hierrezuelo is known as the vocalist of the band Ricoson. He played percussion in the band Temperamento with Roberto Fonseca, Javier Zalba, and Ruy Lopez Nousa, and has worked with artists such as Alfredo Rodriguez and Los Acerekó, Omara Portuondo, Fatoumata Diawara, and Mayra Andrade.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Christian Scott
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: Peter Beets: Chopin meets the Blues
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel - Bandit 65
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty.

programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax’ took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Hayo Hayta
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: For Sephora
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: Jackie Davis in concert in Brussels
programme.desc: American soul jazz singer and organist Jackie Davis (1920-1999) contributed greatly to the popularity of the Hammond B3 organ in jazz, preceding even the great Jimmy Smith. Seen here during an intimate solo performance in Brussels in 1967, we get to enjoy Davis’ every musical twist and lyrical turn.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Visitor from Venus
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra: Changing Faces
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big’ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: 2Cellos
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra And Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Richard Bona - Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz à Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was the wonderful Richard Bona. He conquered the world with his bass and voice a long time ago.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Wynton Marsalis
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Free Jazz in Kongressaal Munich: Cecil Taylor
programme.desc: In the midst of the blossoming of the free-jazz scene, pianist Cecil Taylor (1929) probably represented the non-jazz aspect of the movement better than anyone else. Many of the innovations of the 1960s were pioneered by his records. His fusion of exuberance and atonality was particularly influential.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part I
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York 'discovered' an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music.

programme.desc: Situações que provocam sensações e comportamentos positivos. Cães que brincam, passeiam ou viajam com o focinho ao vento. Imagens que transmitem bons momentos e relações de afeto entre os cães e os donos.

programme.title: Estímulo

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: Diário De Mika

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest intervient à Saint-Bonnet-en-Champsaur, au cœur des Hautes-Alpes. C’est ici que Béatrice et Stéphane ont ouvert leur restaurant il y a presque trois ans. Dès son arrivée, le chef est frappé par l’état des lieux : désordre dès l’entrée, salle sombre et sans âme... Et, en cuisine, la situation se dégrade avec une hygiène plus que douteuse : hotte encrassée, paniers de friteuse noirs et frigo envahi par la glace....

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: C’est à Plougonver en Bretagne que Jessica a fait appel au chef Philippe Etchebest pour lui venir en aide : le restaurant où elle travaille avec son patron Vincent rencontre depuis plusieurs mois une grosse baisse de clientèle. Leur situation financière est au plus mal et leur moral aussi. Lors de sa visite, le Chef a rapidement découvert que Jessica manquait cruellement de professionnalisme. Elle oscillait entre bonne humeur… et...

programme.desc: Ao longo da história, os monumentos colossais dos nossos antepassados refletiram a sua determinação em deixar uma marca duradoura no mundo. O Coliseu guarda segredos profundos do engenho romano. A extensão serpenteante da Grande Muralha da China esconde pistas sobre a sua construção. O Castelo de Malbork demonstra o poder militar dos Cavaleiros Teutónicos.

programme.title: Estruturas Antigas: Enigmas Do Passado T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No Sri Lanka, uma fortaleza ergue-se majestosamente das cinzas vulcânicas. Cabeças de pedra misteriosas pontuam uma ilha remota no Pacífico. Na Índia, um intrincado templo hindu destaca-se como um dos exemplos mais impressionantes de arquitetura esculpida na rocha no mundo. Como conseguiram os construtores aproveitar o legado ígneo da Terra para criar estruturas duradouras que desafiam a compreensão humana? .

programme.title: Estruturas Antigas: Enigmas Do Passado T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Por trás da incrível grandiosidade da cidadela de Sacsayhuamán, no Peru, do poço em degraus de Chand Baori, na Índia, e da Catedral de Notre-Dame, em Paris, estão obras arquitetónicas que ultrapassam os limites do possível. Ao longo dos séculos, estas proezas arquitetónicas inspiraram lendas de intervenção sobrenatural e pactos diabólicos.

programme.title: Estruturas Antigas: Enigmas Do Passado T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A busca da humanidade pela imortalidade deu origem a monumentos que parecem transcender a morte. Do mármore luminoso do Taj Mahal, que simboliza o amor eterno, à cripta dos imperadores salianos na Catedral de Speyer, na Alemanha, e aos majestosos túmulos escavados na rocha da Lícia, na Turquia, estas estruturas revelam como os nossos antepassados enfrentaram a morte e celebraram a vida.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Neste episódio, aprenderemos quantas maneiras há de se embaraçar, se lesionar e humilhar quando sobre ou desce umas escadas ou anda às cavalitas de alguém..

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Assista a este episódio de Science of Stupid para uma experiência cheia de acidentes, quedas, esmagamentos e explosões! Se alguma vez conduziu um carro numa curva apertada, sabe que tem de reduzir a velocidade para manter o atrito entre os seus pneus e a superfície. Estes condutores não o fizeram e foram a girar e a derrapar contra as árvores.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O evento náutico SAIL está de visita à capital. Para a equipa da Estação Central de Amesterdão, este é um dos dias mais movimentados do ano. programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A Estação Central de Amesterdão é a porta de entrada para a cidade. Alexandra e Gusta dedicam-se a ajudar os turistas internacionais. Os oficiais de Segurança e Serviço, Menno e Baran, estão atentos a ladrões de bagagem. No terminal especial do Reino Unido, a equipa corre contra o tempo para garantir que o comboio para Londres parte a horas.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Enquanto a nova ponte ferroviária está a ser instalada, as funcionárias de Segurança And Serviço, Carolien e Zoë, ajudam dois requerentes de asilo que se perderam no caminho.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: No Dia do Rei, feriado nacional nos Países Baixos, os funcionários da Estação Central de Amesterdão não têm mãos a medir. Enquanto Menno e Carolien reanimam uma menina, o resto da equipa tenta controlar o caos na estação.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Para os residentes independentes de Port Protection, o perigo está sempre à espreita. Mary Miller vai para a floresta caçar veados, mas os lobos da zona poderão ameaçar a sua segurança.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em Port Protection ter uma relação simbiótica com a Mãe Natureza é essencial para sobrviver na ilha remota. Com a chegada do Inverno, Gary Muehlberger tenta derrubar uma árvore para reabastecer a lenha de lareira. Mary Miller lida com um convidado inesperado ao recolher proteína nos mares. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Com o Inverno a chegar a Port Protection, os seus habitantes devem fazer tudo o que é possivel para se proteger. Stuart Andrews tenta recolher um 'gigante' da floresta para assegurar que se mantém quente. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Os residentes de Port Protection devem completar tarefas vitais antes da chegada do Inverno, procurando muitas vezes a ajuda de familiares e amigos.

programme.desc: À medida que o Outono dá lugar ao Inverno, os habitantes de Port Protection têm de se adaptar aos caprichos da Mãe Natureza se pretendem sobreviver. Gary Muehlberger vai para a floresta para obter peles de marta valiosas.

programme.title: Tesouros Perdidos Da Grécia Antiga T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Arqueólogos investigam a verdade por detrás das lendas de Hércules, um dos heróis mais famosos da mitologia grega.

programme.title: Tesouros Perdidos Do Egito T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Equipas de arqueólogos investigam a antiga luta pelo poder entre o Egito e os seus vizinhos núbios, que chegaram a governar durante 100 anos.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T8 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Os residentes de quatro patas de Port Protection assumem o papel principal, mostrando a importância da companhia canina no Alasca..

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz enfrentam um dos maiores desafios de sempre: um Golf GTi Mk1 pertencente a um dos maiores fãs da VW em Birmingham. Ao contrário das restaurações anteriores, este não é um simples restauro; é uma missão para criar um carro de sonho que impressione no encontro de automóveis mais importante do Reino Unido. Conseguirão surpreender o público?.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz trabalham num Mini Mayfair extremamente degradado, que havia sido comprado por Donna com a herança do falecido pai. Ela sonhava com um Cooper, mas acabou com um carro enferrujado, e os seus problemas de saúde impediram qualquer restauro. Agora, os rapazes terão de restaurar o que resta e transformar o carro num verdadeiro tributo ao Cooper, com a ajuda da própria família Cooper.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez em Car SOS, Tim e Fuzz deixam de lado quatro rodas para enfrentar o seu restauro mais ambicioso: uma moto Triumph Bonneville de 1973, pertencente ao ex-chefe de correios Ian. Conseguirão transformar este “restolho” de duas rodas num brilhante exemplo do património motociclista britânico a tempo de uma revelação emotiva no coração do País de Gales?.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz trabalham no Nissan Pulsar GTi-R de 1990 de Raymond, o carro de sonho que ele não pôde terminar devido a problemas de saúde. Com a carroçaria corroída e peças espalhadas, este restauro é arriscado devido à raridade do carro. Terão de reconstruir este “Baby Godzilla” do zero para que Raymond, visivelmente emocionado, se reencontre com o seu carro restaurado em Silverstone.

programme.title: Os Melhores Destinos Do Mundo: Guizhou T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Guizhou, na China, distinguida por duas vezes na lista dos melhores destinos do mundo da National Geographic, volta a ser o foco desta segunda temporada. O conceituado fotógrafo e explorador Chris Burkard lidera uma nova e envolvente viagem pela província. Através do seu olhar único, Chris revela as paisagens deslumbrantes, a cultura rica e as comunidades vibrantes de Guizhou. .

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz vão até à Irlanda do Norte para resgatar um Land Rover Defender de 2000 com um passado heroico. Pertence a Shaun, que dedica a vida ao socorro comunitário, está cheio de ferrugem e precisa de grande trabalho mecânico. Conseguirá o SOS Automóvel devolver este herói da linha da frente ao serviço?.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz vão até Shrewsbury com uma missão especial: salvar o Rover P4 de Adam. Pastor dedicado, Adam ajudou milhares de homens a falar sobre saúde mental através da paixão comum pelos carros, mas o seu querido “Wilbur” foi ficando ao abandono. Conseguirá a equipa transformar este clássico dos anos 60 no carro com que sempre sonhou?.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T14 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz deslocam-se a Essex para salvar um Lamborghini à beira da extinção. O Silhouette dos anos 70 de Raymond é um dos raríssimos dez modelos com volante à direita alguma vez construídos, dos quais subsistem menos de cinco. Com peças quase impossíveis de encontrar, um motor problemático e uma viagem a Itália em busca de ajuda, conseguirão salvar este belo exemplar, raro e icónico?.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O Ford Cosworth foi outrora visto como um carro com charme, mas para Darren é apenas um sinónimo de uma tragédia familiar. Será que a equipa consegue restaurá-lo à sua anterior glória?.

programme.title: Bastidores: A Dinastia da Coreia do Norte T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Para desvendar a relação única entre pai e filho, 'O Filho de Deus' segue o declínio de Kim Il Sung e a ascensão do seu filho, Kim Jong Il.

programme.title: One Strange Rock T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Para os poucos privilegiados que olharam para a Terra a partir do espaço, a fina linha azul do nosso planeta é que separa a Terra de qualquer outro planeta que já vimos. Sustém a vida. A história de como a Terra cria e regula a sua atmosfera rica em oxigénio é incrível: um rio voador, uma tempestade de pó global, um glaciar a colapsar e a criatura mais importante que nunca ouviu falar.

programme.title: One Strange Rock T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como é que o nosso planeta chegou aqui? Nasceu numa tempestade cósmica e foi formado pela violência. Apenas estamos aqui por causa de colisões aleatórias num cosmos perigoso. Poderia ter-nos destruído mas, em vez disso, construiu um planeta dos escombros do sistema solar primordial, deu-nos oceanos num bombardeamento dos céus e trouxe-se ordem ao nosso mundo quando dois planetas colidiram..

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O Inverno traz neve, gelo e divertimento, quando desfrutado com moderação! Saltos de mota de neve podem ser muito divertidos até o excesso de rotação e ambição mandar os pilotos contra a neve de cabeça. Deslizar no gelo é sempre uma boa experiência se souber manter o equilíbrio na ausência de fricção! Quando não conseguir, provavelmente irá deslizar com a sua cara. Saltar à corda é uma tarefa simples que envolve velocidade e timing.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No momento em que a implosão de uma ponte ferroviária assinala uma nova fase de reconstrução, um grupo de agentes ajuda uma mulher que caiu numa escada rolante.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Enquanto o Expresso do Oriente chega à estação, a equipa de segurança está ocupada a lidar com um passageiro que não pagou bilhete.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Durante o Grande Prémio de Fórmula 1, os funcionários tentam controlar tanto o fluxo de viajantes como o de mercadorias. .

programme.desc: Durante o Pride Amsterdam, um comboio sem energia avaria nos carris. Os serviços de emergência são chamados para levar os passageiros para um local seguro.

programme.desc: Tony e Amelia carregam as armas para o seu primeiro tiro ao peru, o nómada do deserto Tobias tem dificuldade em encontrar água no deserto, o homem da fronteira Colbert tem um par de mãos frescas para o ajudar com a sua cabine no pântano e o ferreiro Derik tem que usar alguma engenharia das Montanhas Rochosas para descobrir a sua situação de água..

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Bem fundo no pântano, o homem da fronteira Colbert tenta escapar à praga de mosquitos, o madeireiro Thorn entra na floresta para perseguir um peru esquivo, os caseiros Tobias e Amelia tentam impedir que as suas galinhas destruam o jardim e o nómada Tobias apressa-se para encontrar comida antes que o sol se ponha no deserto..

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O homem da fronteira Colbert tira partido das águas altas e perigosas do pântano, transportando materiais para reconstruir a sua cabine, enquanto um urso chega ao campo do madeireiro Thorn, o ferreiro Derik tenta trazer as suas mulas para casa e os caseiros Tony e Amelia apressam-se para terminar o aquecedor pois o frio ameaça o seu gado..

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O Homem da fronteira Colbert começa num frenesim de armadilhas no final da temporada, enquanto Thorn constrói um barco para partir à caça de castores, Tony e Amelia procuram xarope nas árvores e Derik tenta domar as suas mulas agitadas..

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: O nómada do deserto Tobias parte numa demanda perigosa no deserto do Arizona Desert enquanto Derik tenta domar as suas mulas agitadas, Colbert está no rasto de um javali selvagem e a viagem pelo rio abaixo de Thorn para chegar à zona lendária de caça sofre alguns revezes inesperados..

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em Port Protection, os habitantes têm de confiar nas suas capacidades físicas e mentais se querem ser mais espertos do que a mãe natureza. Oliver e Breanna partem na sua primeira caça ao urso. Curly orienta Morgan quando esta derruba a sua primeira árvore. Sam usa a ciência para adoçar o seu primeiro solo de plantação. Mary desenvolve um novo método para cozinhar o seu peixe.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: As residências juntam-se, combinando o saber de experiência feito e a força da juventude para assegurar o futuro de Port Protection. Sam, Carl e Troy constroem um transportador de troncos essencial para as suas propriedades futuras. Curly está ansioso por um pouco de coração e fígado, por isso vai para a floresta em busca de um jovem cervo. Squibb e Chris fazem uma melhoria significativa na sua infraestrutura. .

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Para os cidadãos de Port Protection, nada que valha a pena é fácil de obter. Oliver tenta construir uma máquina de lavar a partir de barris e madeira. Sam ensina Troy a pescar usando uma rede de emalhar. Mary tem esperança de apanhar camarão.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No pino do verão, os habitantes de Port Protection vão em busca de proteína para o inverno. Sam constrói uma arma para Troy para que ele possa tentar a sua sorte na caça submarina no Alasca. Morgan vai com Matt em busca de veados e consegue caçar um cervo pela primeira vez. Squibb deixa redes para apanhar alabote.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 7

Curly parte na esperança de apanhar caranguejo e berbigão. Bre e Oliver constroem um quebra-mar para proteger a sua casa flutuante. David Squib inicia alguns projetos de manutenção cruciais dentro e ao redor da sua propriedade.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Os cidadãos de Port Protection correm contra o tempo para construir abrigo para o novo residente antes que o inverno brutal e implacável assole a cidade.

programme.desc: Os cidadãos de Port Protection correm contra o tempo para construir abrigo para o novo residente antes que o inverno brutal e implacável assole a cidade.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T5 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Com a chegada do inverno, Matt arrasta-se através de ventos fortes, chuva e neve, determinado a assegurar alguns veados para os longos meses que se avizinham.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: China T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hazen junta-se aos Biasha, a última tribo autorizada a usar armas na China, na sua aldeia montanhosa em Guizhou. Na sua estadia com a tribo, Hazen tem de dominar enormes búfalos e enfrentar cobras.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: China T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Hazen Audel junta-se aos Evenki nas florestas da Mongólia Interior, onde aprende a montar renas, pelas quais a tribo nutre grande apreço, e protegê-las dos ursos e linces nas noites escuras.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Sobreviver À Amazónia T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Na primeira parte do seu percurso de 800 km pela Amazónia, Hazen tem de escapar às cheias da estação chuvosa e, depois, usar os métodos tradicionais do povo Wai Wai para sobreviver aos perigos da selva.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Sobreviver À Amazónia T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Na segunda parte do seu desafio na Amazónia, Hazen junta-se aos cowboys Wapishana num percurso com o gado antes de enfrentar uma anaconda gigante, cascavéis venenosas e uma travessia de rio perigosa para evitar as cheias.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Sobreviver À Amazónia T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Na terceira parte do seu desafio, Hazen enfrenta a floresta da montanha Kanuku Mountain usando as competências de sobrevivência dos habitantes locais antes de prender enguias elétricas e invadir uma floresta de bambu impenetrável.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: Sobreviver À Amazónia T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Na quarta parte do seu desafio, Hazen usa as competências do povo Arekuna para enfrentar cascatas, aranhas que esguicham fezes e a cobra mais perigosa do mundo.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Agentes marítimos em Miami intercetam uma embarcação que transporta mais de 500 quilos de cocaína. Entretanto, agentes da Patrulha de Fronteira do Mississippi montam uma operação numa importante autoestrada, suspeita de estar a ser utilizada por cartéis para o contrabando de droga, dinheiro e pessoas.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Agentes em Fort Lauderdale intercetam uma grande remessa de marijuana que sai dos Estados Unidos. No Mississippi, agentes da Patrulha de Fronteira policiam a I-10, uma rota de contrabando conhecida.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Agentes no Porto de Savannah intercetam um contentor com carros roubados. No Aeroporto Internacional de Nova Orleães, a equipa K-9 é mobilizada quando uma mala é assinalada por suspeitas de conter narcóticos.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Em Porto Rico, agentes intercetam uma embarcação de contrabando que transporta 201 quilos de cocaína. No Mississippi, uma equipa vigia uma rota conhecida pelo tráfico de mercadorias ilegais no sul dos Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Melbourne T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Fazer descolar o maior avião de passageiros do mundo exige um grande trabalho de equipa. Além disso, o aeroporto enfrenta congestionamentos quando uma falha informática atinge os serviços fronteiriços.
