programme.title: Asia's Weirdest T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Asia’s animal kingdom has a seedy underbelly where assassins have developed more weird ways to despatch victims than other species could ever fathom.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Life isn’t easy. To survive one must adapt, but not all of evolution’s gifts are equal. Some animals are weirder than others—meet the mutants.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird and Wild introduces the Kinabatangan River. Between the deluge of wet season flooding and daily tides, this is a place of extremes. The river's power sustains and binds together the lives of elephants, crocodiles, orangutans, and hornbills. Otters, odd long-nosed monkeys, and fish that walk on land navigate the shape-shifting labyrinth..

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas - Ep. 1
programme.desc: National Geographic goes to Botswana to examine the struggle for survival between lions and hyenas.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Asia’s animal kingdom has a seedy underbelly where assassins have developed more weird ways to despatch victims than other species could ever fathom.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Life isn’t easy. To survive one must adapt, but not all of evolution’s gifts are equal. Some animals are weirder than others—meet the mutants.

programme.title: An Elephant's World - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Untamed Americas T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate journey through America's deserts. Everything in the desert lives and dies at the mercy of water. Dry, inhospitable wilderness, they are among the harshest, most extreme environments on the planet. Wind and water sculpt these thirst-lands into natural monuments… as unique as they are spectacular.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory. .

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm. .

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard’s hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: If you're a forest predator, success requires using trees to bridge the gap between life and death. In this realm, danger - or your next meal - could be behind you, below, or above you. Whether you're a Harpy eagle, zeroing in on prey from high in the rainforest canopy, a cunning weasel, scouring for a meal in and out of mossy logs, or a Bengal tiger, trying to stalk in a bare, dry forest, catching prey among the trees is a challenge.

programme.title: American Amazon T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands, slackens at the shoals of the fall line, floods across vast deltas, and reunites with the wild ocean. It’s an immersive encounter with stunning wildlife, up-close natural history, and surprising revelations from source to sea.

programme.title: Secret Life of Predators T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Worldwide, predators that inhabit open spaces must hide in plain sight in order to thrive. On the vast plains of the African savanna, banded mongooses rely on strength in numbers in order to succeed in a land of giants. .

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The rush is on! Dr. Pol and the team tackle urgent back-to-back cases. The vets piece together a mangled mutt, do a check-up on cuddly chinchillas, deflate a severely bloated steer, and rectify some literal pain in the butts.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: It’s a real dog and pony show at Pol Vet! Doc assists a young mare in an emergency foaling and Dr. Lisa treats a Great Dane with a swollen face. Goats with coccidia fight for their lives and a stray cat fights treatment. A cat is full of gas; a pig has lost his potbelly. A Black Lab is brought in with a stinker of a problem. Rowdy angus cattle get pregnancy checks and winter arrives in Michigan.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: From fights and falls to geckos and goats, Doc and the vets save the day! A pig with a prolapse, a plethora of puppies, and an adorable vet-to-be keep things rolling. Dr. Pol mends a Dachshund after a vicious fight with another dog, Dr. Lisa assists in an emergency twin goat kidding, and Dr. Nicole removes a painful nail from a horse’s hoof. Meanwhile, the Pol family gets some exciting baby news.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The battle between predator and prey is not always about power and strength. Knowing what lurks in the dark can mean the difference between life and death. Extraordinary powers that penetrate darkness give some creatures the edge, and the chance to live another day.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: In nature, the prevailing rule is ‘eat or be eaten.’ Avoiding predators and competition for space, food, and mates is a priority for every animal. But before you can attack, you need to be able to defend yourself. After eons of evolution, animals have developed powerful and surprising defensive techniques that help them avoid, overcome, or escape challengers.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard’s hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar’s Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can’t escape the harsh merciless winter.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises.

programme.title: Big Little Giants - Ep. 1

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: The Pol’s new livestock aren’t potty trained; their sheep hut isn’t draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It’s late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol’s also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth’s dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden’s pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms Of China T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: China's bamboo forest is full of secrets and surprises, including the legendary giant panda, red panda and Tibetan macaque, and a host of other unusual creatures such as the jewelled flower mantis, bamboo bats and moustached toads that have found ingenious ways to survive in this kingdom of giant grass.

programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar’s Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can’t escape the harsh merciless winter.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Seen On Safari T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Safari action is unpredictable, unexpected and utterly raw. Heroes and underdogs swap roles as nature’s heartbreak can turn breathtaking in an instant. On safari, you’ll witness nature’s most astonishing characters.

programme.title: Seen On Safari T1 - Ep. 1

Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Jaguars Vs. Crocs - Ep. 1

A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.
